title: Deprecated 'cls' kwarg forwarded to http.parse_cookie
detail: The wrapper still accepts **kwargs and forwards them to `http.parse_cookie`. Since `http.parse_cookie` does not accept a `cls` argument, callers that set `kwargs['cls']` (e.g., in `Request.cookies`) will receive a TypeError. This breaks existing behavior and tests that rely on the custom dict class.

title: UnicodeEncodeError on non‑latin1 cookie header
detail: The code assumes the cookie header string contains only latin‑1 characters. If the header contains any Unicode code point outside the latin‑1 range, `cookie.encode("latin1")` will raise a `UnicodeEncodeError`, causing the request to fail.
